method: Five-verse bounded first-pass comparison; inspected prior 14:1–5 staging and absence of target file on PR #445 branch; checked default-branch search and live source-related table inventory. No critical-language collation, full cross-PR ledger reconciliation or public source verification.

records.note: Moses reminds his people of deliverance from Pharaoh's people, including oppression and killing sons while sparing women. Exodus 1 is a specific earlier narrative candidate, but Qur'anic verse includes theological framing and no named Egypt here.

candidates.similarity: Oppression of Israelites and killing male children under Pharaoh
candidates.difference: Exodus narrates Egyptian forced labor and Pharaoh's commands; Q14:6 recalls deliverance and describes the experience as a great trial.
candidates.pending: Collate Hebrew critical text, translation, witnesses and textual variants; examine Q14:6 wording and assess cross-verse dossier before public promotion.

records.note: Gratitude linked to increase and ingratitude to punishment; widespread ethical theology. No sufficiently distinctive pre-Islamic textual parallel established in this limited screen.
God's independence from human belief and praise is a general theological claim; no source-specific textual parallel established in this preliminary pass.
Names Noah, ʿĀd and Thamūd and other past communities. Noah's narrative has a clear earlier textual tradition; ʿĀd/Thamūd should not be forced into biblical identifications.

candidates.relationship: shared Noah tradition; broad narrative allusion
candidates.similarity: Noah is an earlier figure associated with a people and divine judgment
candidates.difference: Q14:9 is a compressed warning referencing several peoples and the rejection of messengers; Genesis narrates the flood and covenant at length, without ʿĀd or Thamūd.
candidates.pending: Assess Genesis passages in Hebrew and critical translation; compare early Jewish/Christian Noah reception, source history and Qur'anic Noah passages; do not assert a verse-specific direct borrowing.

records.note: Messengers question doubt concerning God, creator of heavens and earth, and call to forgiveness. Common creation and prophetic appeal language; look for distinctive locators before suggesting a public parallel.
